tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Infinite differentiability up to the boundary] ↗ thm:higher-boundary-regularity ↗ thm:general-sobolev-inequalities 1. ch6:6.3-thm-6\group Regularity Theory

Assume \[ a^{ij}, b^i, c \in C^\infty (\bar U) \quad (i,j=1,\ldots ,n) \] and \[ f \in C^\infty (\bar U). \] Suppose $u \in H_0^1(U)$ is a weak solution of the boundary-value problem \[ \begin{cases} Lu = f & \text{in } U \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U. \end{cases} \] Assume also that $\partial U$ is $C^\infty $. Then \[ u \in C^\infty (\bar U). \]

Proof

\sketch Higher boundary regularity yields $H^k(U)$ for every $k$. Sobolev embedding on the smooth bounded domain gives $C^\infty (\bar U)$.

□
